Se il tuo browser non riesce a raggiunge: If your browser can't reach Alpaca and you choose to route the Paper account through the Tradermon service, the Paper keys pass through the Supabase function only for the duration of the request and are not stored. The function logs each order (security, quantity, side, outcome) together with the player's identifier, never the keys.
I dati servono solo a far funzionare il: The data is used only to run the game. We don't sell it, we don't use it for advertising and we don't make automated decisions about you.
Il gioco usa solo il conto <b>Paper</b>: The game uses only Alpaca's Paper account, with fake money. The account is yours, opened by you on Alpaca's site. When you link the keys, it's your browser that talks to Alpaca: keys, orders, positions and IP address reach Alpaca, which processes them as an independent controller under its own terms and privacy notice (Alpaca's documents). Tradermon doesn't receive this information and has no access to your account.
<b>Supabase</b> conserva giocatori e sal: Supabase stores players and saves, as a provider processing data on behalf of the controller. The project is in Supabase's European region (Ireland). Supabase is a company based in the United States: any access from abroad is covered by Supabase's data processing agreement, with the European Commission's standard contractual clauses.
<b>GitHub</b> ospita le pagine del sito: GitHub hosts the site and game pages (GitHub Pages) and records visitors' IP addresses for the security of the service, under its own privacy statement.
Il sito non carica script, caratteri o i: The site doesn't load scripts, fonts or images from other services.
Il gioco usa la memoria del browser (loc: The game uses browser storage (localStorage and IndexedDB), not cookies. They are all technical tools, needed for the service you ask for: that's why your consent isn't needed and there's no banner. None of this data is used to follow you on other sites.
